correctness.rationale: Kernel dimension h=(q+1)^3 and Jacobi addition normalization rederived; all 9 off-diagonal entries equal h a_q, so the two Gram branches are exact. Polynomial orthogonality gives P_q^(1,0)(x)=(P_q(x)-P_(q+1)(x))/(1-x). Exact rational recurrence for q<=19 and the independent Legendre integral bound |P_n|<=1 for all n yield a rigorous infinite tail bound for q>=20. The 56/25 condition envelope is equivalent to -31/473 <= a <=31/256; only q3 has equality by finite exact check and strict analytic tail. The checker tested three independent SIC family angles and finite Gram entries; it is confirmatory, not a substitute for the unbounded analytic argument. All hypotheses and normalizations are stated.

value.rationale: The nine-line SIC is a canonical complex-projective equiangular configuration, and interpolation by individual phase-invariant harmonic bidegrees is a natural precise invariant. Beyond a rank table, the unique sharp all-degree worst conditioning 56/25 and uniform reconstruction over all nine-line configurations provide a quantitative stability barrier and reusable kernel formula. A nontrivial all-integer finite-to-infinite argument is needed; not a generic substitution or a single computed instance.
